name: howto
title: How to check a Black Friday price in five minutes
sub: The same six steps work for every pick in this guide
footer: Sources: Google Shopping price insights and tracking (Google blog), FTC consumer advice on inflated "original" prices, Consumer Reports deal coverage. Our synthesis.

items.head: Set the number
items.body: Before the sale, write the price you would pay. Use our band for each pick, not the banner.

items.head: Match the model
items.body: Compare the model number: 300-P vs 300S-P, Duo vs Duo Plus, 4-qt vs 6-qt. Deals often name a cousin.

items.head: Check the history
items.body: Chrome's Google Shopping price insights show the last 90 days and label a price low, typical or high.

items.head: Compare three stores
items.body: Open the brand's store, Walmart and Target or Home Depot. The listed "was" price is often a high list price.

items.head: Read the returns
items.body: Holiday windows run to January at most big stores. Home Depot keeps its normal 90 days.

items.head: Pay by card, keep the proof
items.body: A credit card adds dispute protection (FTC). Save the order number and receipt.
